blurb: Guests can enjoy an 18-hole natural mini golf course designed by local golf legend Scott Hoffman, set on the shores of Crystal Lake. The site offers a variety of non-motorized watercraft rentals including kayaks, paddle boards, canoes, sailboats, water bikes, and paddle boats. Additional amenities include a bottle shop, coffee shop, gourmet food, and a golf simulator.
